item.tib: rgyal yum byams ma chen mo'i maN Dal bzhi chog bsam don lhun grub
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang snga sor glang lo nang rang gsang phug tu gnas dus/ grub dbang rin po che nas byams ma'i maN Dal bzhi chog dgos 'dug bka' phebs rung skabs thog der 'bul thabs nges pa ma byung bar btang snyoms su gyur pa phyis yos lo tha skar zla ba'i 'phel phyogs su bu med seng la zhon pa zhig gis byams ma'i maN Dal bzhi chog 'dod na/ byams ma chen mo la mgron bzhis bskor ba so sor sbyar te phul nas rung / zhes su gsungs bar rang la'ang (lag)len gzhung lugs 'di bzhin snyams pa'i bag chags shin tu gsal bar ran 'dug pa la brten nas mkhan mchog nyi ri shel bzhin gyis 'phral brtsams bgyis pas/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ dge bas bon gyi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/
